jobs.name: Diagnose exact retained dsp XDL exports

steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v6
Locate isolated evidence directories on the hosted runner
Pin diagnostic sources and inventory every tracked input
Validate hosted export-analysis controls
Bind original MAP evidence and preserve exact later export-gate failures
Run ./.github/actions/prepare-build-image
Produce two controlled read-only exports of the identical retained NCD
Preserve full fresh XDL exports separately on GitHub
Retain exact export differences and original-record comparisons
Require complete source, evidence and export inventories unchanged
Retain bounded text diagnosis reports
Post Run actions/checkout@v6
Complete job
